series.name: RAC / low-evidence codes (title-only)
series.notes: AAMIR TECH RAC title-only codes (F1 F2 F3 F4 F8 RO R1) + related low-evidence. Captions unavailable — low confidence. Not merged with CSDC meanings.

title.ur: F1 (RAC list) — matlab abhi nikala nahi gaya

meaning.en: Listed in RAC error video title with F2 F3 F4 F8 RO R1. Auto-captions are music only.
meaning.ur: RAC error video ke title mein F2 F3 F4 F8 RO R1 ke saath yeh bhi shamil hai. Auto captions mein sirf music hai.

causes.en: Presumed sensor-class fault like split series — unconfirmed for RAC
causes.ur: Andaza split series ke mutabiq sensor class ka masla hai — RAC ke liye tasdeq nahi hui
Manual/video ka insani review zaroori hai

solutions.en: Watch video manually; do not apply split-CSDC blink counts blindly
solutions.ur: Video khud dekhein; split-CSDC ke blink counts bina sochay na lagayein

solutions.en: Request manufacturer service sheet for RAC
solutions.ur: RAC ke liye company ki service sheet maangein

notes.en: BLOCKER: no captions; meanings must not be copied from split tables without proof.
notes.ur: BLOCKER: captions nahi hain; split tables se matlab bina proof ke copy nahi karne chahiye.

meaning.en: Appears in RAC title as RO (or OCR R0). Could be mis-typed code or RO-as-zero. Not confirmed.
meaning.ur: RAC title mein RO (ya OCR ka R0) ke tor par aata hai. Ho sakta hai code ghalat type hua ho ya RO ka matlab zero ho. Tasdeq nahi hui.

causes.ur: Nalam — imkan hai ye R0 ki ghalat recording ho

causes.en: Must not be confused with RO water purifier filters
causes.ur: Isay RO water purifier ke filters se ghalat na lein

solutions.en: Do not act on this code yet — have a human review the original video frames first to confirm whether it reads RO or R0.
solutions.ur: Abhi is code par koi kaam na karein — pehle koi insani review kare ke video ke frames par likha RO hai ya R0.

solutions.en: Compare the on-screen code against the RAC list so a mis-read R0 is not treated as a separate RO appliance code.
solutions.ur: Screen par likha code RAC list se mila lein taake ghalat parha gaya R0 ko koi alag RO appliance code na le sake.

solutions.en: Keep the entry quarantined until a second source confirms the meaning, and never confuse it with water-purifier (RO) parts.
solutions.ur: Doosra source matlab confirm hone tak entry ko quarantine mein rakhein, aur ise kabhi water-purifier (RO) parts ke sath na milayein.

notes.en: QUARANTINE-adjacent: risk of RO appliance confusion.
notes.ur: QUARANTINE ke qareeb: RO appliance ke sath ghulne ka khatra.

title.en: F8 (RAC list) — see Blue Corner PT sensor note
title.ur: F8 (RAC list) — Blue Corner PT sensor ka note dekhein

meaning.en: Listed in RAC title. On split DC inverter videos, F8 = point/pipe temperature sensor (unconfirmed for RAC).
meaning.ur: RAC title mein shamil hai. Split DC inverter videos mein F8 ka matlab hai point/pipe temperature sensor (RAC ke liye tasdeq nahi).

causes.en: Possible pipe/point sensor fault if same mapping
causes.ur: Agar mapping waisi hi ho to pipe/point sensor ka masla ho sakta hai

solutions.en: Treat as sensor candidate only after confirming series
solutions.ur: Sirf series ki tasdeq ke baad ise sensor ke mutabiq dekhein

solutions.en: Use manufacturer RAC documentation if obtained
solutions.ur: Agar mil jaye to company ki RAC documentation istemal karein

source.title: Changhang Ruba Error Code || Rac Error Code|| F1 F2 F3 F4 F8 RO R1

notes.en: Cross-ref only: WmLIJdK04z0 split F8=PT sensor.
notes.ur: Sirf cross-ref ke tor par: split ke F8=PT sensor ka zikr WmLIJdK04z0 mein hai.

title.en: R1 (RAC list) — see DC inverter R1
title.ur: R1 (RAC list) — DC inverter wala R1 dekhein

meaning.en: Listed in RAC title. DC inverter R1 documented as outdoor kit low voltage fault (may or may not match RAC).
meaning.ur: RAC title mein shamil hai. DC inverter R1 ko outdoor kit low voltage fault likha gaya hai (shayad RAC se match kare, shayad nahi).

causes.en: Possible outdoor kit low voltage if same as split
causes.ur: Agar split jaisa hi ho to outdoor kit low voltage ka imkan hai

solutions.en: Disconnect power, then measure the supply voltage at the outdoor kit input with a multimeter before replacing any part.
solutions.ur: Bijli band karein, phir koi part badalne se pehle multimeter se bahar ke kit ke input par supply voltage naapein.

solutions.en: Compare the reading with the rated supply in the manual; a low reading points to wiring or supply, not to the kit.
solutions.ur: Reading ko manual ki rating se compare karein; voltage kam aaye to masla wiring ya supply ka hai, kit ka nahi.

solutions.en: Confirm the same low-voltage fault on this RAC hardware before fitting a new outdoor kit.
solutions.ur: Naya outdoor kit lagane se pehle isi RAC hardware par confirm karein ke yahi low-voltage fault hai.
